Ten minutes of help. More kids went to college.
The college aid form: eight pages, over a hundred questions.
In 2008, tax offices in Ohio and North Carolina tried something.
While families did taxes, the aid form got pre-filled. The rest took under ten minutes.
Their teens' college enrollment: about twenty-seven percent, up to thirty-five.
But families only told their aid amount, with no form help? Applications didn't budge.
The money was there. The form was the wall.
Ten minutes of help beat knowing about the money.
